name: Oikawa Tasuku
source:
[url=https://vndb.org/c19116]Akihito[/url] and [url=https://vndb.org/c204]Kazuto[/url]'s friend at St. Francesca.

All the girls in the school run away from him (with some exceptions) because he is known and reputed to be the greatest of the perverts. He is very unlucky from the romantic point of view because, among the girls who dare to talk to him, none wants to go out with him : "With Oikawa-kun? It's just impossible and inconceivable".

[spoiler]In [url=https://vndb.org/c11966]Yuika[/url]'s route, he falls in love and confesses his feelings to Yuika at the same time as Akihito. Yuika decides to choose him instead of Akihito. However, he soon realizes that Yuika is always thinking of Akihito during their dates and that her true love feelings are for Akihito but that she conceals them for some obscure reason ...

He then decides to put Akihito's ideas back in place so that he can make Yuika happy.[/spoiler]
